opaque_id.description: Opaque server-issued or server-registered identifier, never a name, path, free-text label, or authority. Resolve within the authenticated organization; do not infer access from syntax.

external_id.description: Verified connector source identifier. The connector must select the source ID field, never encode a title, path, URL, body, or actor name as an ID.

count.description: Non-negative JSON-safe exact count. Unknown is represented by explicit null only where the containing field permits it.

timestamp.description: Valid UTC RFC3339 instant with at most microsecond precision. Invalid calendar dates are rejected; no local or client-implied time zone.

decimal.description: Exact non-negative base-10 quantity with at most 18 integral and 9 fractional digits. Not a binary float, scientific notation, or implicit currency conversion.

digest.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest of approved canonical metadata or a tenant-keyed provenance digest. Never a raw content hash substituted for retained work content.

reason_code.description: Fixed content-free classification, never caller free text or the rejected value.

schema_version.description: Version 1 of this planned wire contract.

organization_id.description: Server-resolved organization; output only, never accepted as input authority.

source_delivery_id.description: Verified signed delivery identity for idempotency.

external_object_id.description: Opaque source issue or pull-request ID.

source_revision.description: Verified source revision, or explicit unknown; never order guessed from content.

event_type.description: Normalized lifecycle/quality observation; unsupported observations remain explicit.

quality_state.description: Source-qualified quality state, never a model or employee quality inference.

duration_ms.description: Source-supported duration only; null if absent or unsupported.

evidence_level.description: Connectors cannot emit associated or controlled evidence.

provenance_digest.description: Tenant-keyed metadata provenance; no raw webhook stored.

event_at.description: Source/domain event time as observed; never scope authority.

ingested_at.description: Database commit time authoritative for receipt and retention.

hormuz.work-outcome-event.description: Strict normalized connector observation. Source names, text, URLs, comments, labels, patches, and raw payloads are excluded.

schema_version.description: Version 1 of this planned wire contract.

organization_id.description: Server-resolved organization; output only, never accepted as input authority.

disposition.description: A valid receipt never represents a forged, conflicting, or unauthorized delivery.

accepted_event_count.description: Normalized metadata events committed atomically for the delivery.

ingested_at.description: Original durable receipt commit time, retained on exact duplicate replay.

hormuz.connector-ingest-receipt.description: Content-free receipt only after verified signature, tenant binding, and durable commit. Replay returns the original receipt.

schema_version.description: Version 1 of this planned wire contract.

organization_id.description: Server-resolved organization; output only, never accepted as input authority.

items.description: Authorized frozen-window records in deterministic time-plus-ID order.

as_of.description: Frozen query snapshot ceiling; unchanged across cursor pages.

has_more.description: True only if another authorized page exists.

next_cursor.description: Non-null exactly when has_more is true; cursor binds scope, filters, window, ordering, and schema.

hormuz.work-outcome-page.description: Closed collection envelope. Unsupported role/resource combinations are denied before query; this schema never grants access.

opaque_cursor.description: Server-authenticated opaque cursor, never a raw SQL offset or tenant selector.
